causal_design_mismatch.description: The I3.5 report claims the treatment is governor vs no-governor, but the runner invokes governor.assess() and serialize_governor_packet() for both blind and aware arms. The blind condition still receives a governor frame, making the causal governor claim invalid.
evidence: Runner code: i3_5_full_runner.py calls governor.assess() for both conditions
Serializer: i3_5_model_packet.py always includes governor frame
Report claims governor vs no-governor comparison

duplicate_experiment_identities.description: Two incompatible I3.5 experiment identity files exist with different governor and action-semantics hashes.

receipt_report_mismatch.description: Receipts contain HTTP 402 (Payment Required) backend errors, but the report claims zero backend errors.

stats_analysis_sign_conflict.description: The stats file and analysis file report contradictory ΔDG signs.

report_count_invariant_failure.description: Report disagreement tables may have counts that do not sum to the task population N.
report_count_invariant_failure.evidence: Report generation lacks accounting assertions. The I3.4.1 corrected report had categories summing to 510 for a 300-task population.
